topic: The Wood Sheep month (July 7–Aug 7, 2026) is the Soulmate Month of the Fire Horse year. A love-charged window where major life events cluster and passion runs high, but so do tempers. Every sign gets specific guidance: about half are favored, about half are challenged.
phrases: Passion without intention is just heat.
The biggest moments of your year land here.
Tend the garden before the fire runs the garden.

images.concept: The eve of the most love-charged month of the year. A woman standing at the threshold of something significant, the warmth ahead of her, the hard months behind.
images.prompt: A cinematic 16:9 photograph. A woman stands in a doorway, her back to camera, looking out toward a warm amber and rose dusk. She is dressed simply. Her posture is still. Not hesitant, just present. The world beyond the doorway glows with firelight warmth; the room behind her is in shadow. The feeling is anticipation without urgency: she knows something significant is about to begin. Palette: midnight jade shadow in the room, antique gold and dusty rose in the light beyond, warm ivory skin. Film still quality. No faces visible. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Two people on the edge of a significant moment. The space between connection and decision, passion and restraint.
images.prompt: A cinematic 16:9 wide shot of a moonlit garden in summer. Two silhouettes stand a few feet apart, facing a reflecting pool that mirrors the moon above. The scene is charged with unspoken feeling. They are close but not touching, both looking at the water rather than each other. Fireflies drift in the warm air. The night feels like a held breath. Palette: deep midnight jade sky, antique gold moonlight on the water, soft sage in the garden foliage, dusty rose in a distant lantern glow. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: The charged space between connection and decision. Two hands reaching toward each other, almost touching, the gap between them the real subject.
images.prompt: A close-up square photograph. Two hands (one feminine, one masculine) reaching across a dark wooden surface toward each other but not quite touching. The gap between the fingertips is the center of the frame. Warm candlelight from below illuminates the hands against a midnight jade shadow background. The hands are the only subjects; no faces, no bodies beyond the wrists. The feeling is loaded: the moment just before a decision is made. Palette: warm ivory skin, midnight jade surface, antique gold candlelight. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Intention before passion. The act of deciding what you want before walking into a charged month.
images.text: Passion without intention is just heat.
images.prompt: A 16:9 typographic composition. Warm aged parchment background with subtle shadow at the edges, like a page held to candlelight. Rendered in confident hand-inked brush lettering in deep walnut ink, centered on the page, the phrase: "Passion without intention is just heat." Two lines. The lettering is modern calligraphy, not ornate. Elegant and direct. A single small ink flourish beneath. Below the text in the lower right, a faint impression of a candle flame in watercolor. Barely visible, like a ghost image. Palette: warm cream parchment, walnut brown ink, faint antique gold in the flame watermark. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman at the desk of intentional preparation. Journal, morning light, the act of knowing what she wants before the month begins.
images.prompt: A square overhead flat lay. A woman's hands writing in an open journal on a warm ivory surface. Beside the journal: a ceramic tea cup, a lit candle in a small brass holder, and a single dried flower. The journal is open to a blank page. She is about to write. The image conveys the moment of deliberate intention before action. Shot from directly above. Warm, soft morning light from the upper left. Palette: warm ivory paper and surface, antique gold candle holder, soft sage in the dried flower, midnight jade in the journal cover. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
